~The Seventh Warrior~ is a retro-themed, SNES-style RPG that tells the story of "Dark" the demonic crown prince of hell, who nearly conquered the world a thousand years ago but was able to be stopped and sealed away in the end. Now, a thousand years later, the demon prince returns after the seal is broken by fools who believed they could control him - how wrong they were.
Hellbent on revenge, Dark is once again on a mission to take over the world but things are very different nowadays; back then he had an army of thousands of demons, orcs and undead under his command. This time he must do things alone. Soon Dark realizes that the world he once brought death and destruction to has drastically changed; the big empires he fought against are gone, new lands were discovered and new wars are threatening the world. And so it seems our demon lord is only one of many threats that could plunge the world into chaos...
If you are tired of mimmicking the shiny sparkling hero and would rather rule the world than save it, if you want a humorous, chanllenging, storydriven game experience in 90's retro RPG style then this game is for you!
The world is yours... will you take it back?
Spoiler:
Screenshots
Spoiler:
Features
- Go on an epic 40+ hour journey through a huge fantastic world, explore villages, cities and many other places and meet hundreds of interesting characters!
-Decide which path your fate will take with the Karma System: Your decisions control which path you will take. Will you come back as the horrible monster you are known as in the history books and bring death and pain to the world? Or will you walk on the path of light helping people and proving yourself with good deeds?
- Overcome dozens of beautifully designed dungeons and solve tricky puzzles on your way to world domination!
- Fight in epic challenging battles and beat your enemies in a battle system inspired by the Breath of Fire series with fully animated characters and monsters!
- Voice Acting in battles
- Discover a beautifully crafted soundtrack featuring awesome artists like Sam Machin!
- Show your skills in a variety of mini games
Where will the journey and your decisions lead you? Find out for yourself in a retro styled RPG inspired by the glorious SNES era!
I hope I could wake your interest and you like what you see
-DOWNLOAD-
We really appreciate any support we can get to make this game a reality!

posts.author: DerKIAS
posts.body:
@PaulH
Thank you very much! Glad you like it!
Spoiler:
Healing Blossoms
The Healing Blossoms sidequest is badly designed as it is right now because you can only can get the flower when Dark can swim. I will change the position of the flower so that no swimming is required.
Spoiler:
Insect Quest
The insect quest is also not explained well. You can find the insects on different places on the island but I guess there are too well hidden. Also I should give an example of such an insect right where Insect Collector is, so that the player knows what he needs to look out for.
Spoiler:
Farm Estate
Ok so you managed to get through the Farm Estate quest. Was it too difficult to figure out what to do? Any ideas or suggestions how to make it easier to understand?
We have no ETA yet on the full release. The demo includes only the first chapter of 12...^^ So you can probably imagine how much work we still have before us. We plan to build a bigger team to speed up development while still keeping the quality of the game. We hope for crowdfunded support of the fans to enable us to hand out lots of commissions at once and pay other developers to work with us so progress becomes way faster. We hope for support on Patreon for that, but we also may start a Kickstarter campaign sometime.
Greetings, Kias

Honestly this is a really rare issue because most people should have everything necessary installed by default. In fact you are the first person telling me about that issue since the game released. I only knew about this issue before because on a crappy PC of a friend of mine this issue popped up and that was because his Windows installation was kinda buggy for some reason.
We use
RGD
for our game that's the only "abnormal" thing. And we use that because it gives VX Ace a huge performance boost which allows us to do things that would usually cause a lot of lag.
I gave you the solution for your problem. It is pretty easy and fast to fix. If that's too much to ask of you so you can play the game then so be it. I'm always happy for feedback, but if you don't want to play the game anymore, I can live with that.
